verdict.rationale: Cloudflare explicitly and repeatedly publishes an at-cost/no-markup guarantee ('you only pay what is charged by registries and ICANN') with upfront pricing and no hidden add-ons, and one independent HN commenter confirms Cloudflare charges 'the exact same price as the registry wholesale price.' However, there is no itemized per-domain fee breakdown (ICANN fee vs. registry fee vs. any Cloudflare cost), and multiple community reports show Cloudflare actually charging more than competitors for specific TLDs (.io, .space), plus at least one billing/double-charge complaint, which muddies the 'near-wholesale' framing without outright falsifying the no-markup claim. Missing for 10: line-item registry/ICANN fee breakdown per domain, third-party audit of margins, and resolution of documented cases where Cloudflare's price exceeds other registrars' retail rates.
